snippet.title: City Tales: Medieval Era - Full Release Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy the game now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265070/City_Tales__Medieval_Era/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=FullReleaseTrailer

City Tales is a medieval strategic city builder with an organic building system, allowing you to create vast cities where every stone tells a tale. Balance your resources and plan each district while the lives of your companions and people unfold. 
You can also buy the Fluffy Companions DLC to add cute pets to your city: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4246820/City_Tales__Medieval_Era__Fluffy_Companions/
